Appendix 1
Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Appendix 1] <Amended on July 21, 2026>
Qualifications for environmental educators (related to Article 15(1))

| Category | Qualification criteria |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Grade 1 environmental educator | (a) A person who, after obtaining a Grade 2 environmental educator certificate, has at least three years of experience in environmental education-related work and has completed the Grade 1 environmental educator training course operated by an environmental educator training institution. |
| 1. Grade 1 environmental educator | (b) A person who, after obtaining a master's degree or higher in a field related to environmental education, has completed the Grade 1 environmental educator training course operated by an environmental educator training institution. |
| 1. Grade 1 environmental educator | (c) A person who has at least six years of experience in environmental education-related work and has completed the Grade 1 environmental educator training course operated by an environmental educator training institution. |
| 2. Grade 2 environmental educator | A person who has completed the Grade 2 environmental educator training course operated by an environmental educator training institution. |

Notes
1. "Environmental education-related work" means planning, conducting, analyzing or evaluating environmental education programs, or performing environmental education work, carried out at public educational institutions or social environmental education institutions, organizations, etc.
2. The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries (limited to the marine environmental field) shall determine and publicly notify detailed matters, including the educational content, completion requirements and evaluation methods for environmental educator training courses operated by environmental educator training institutions.
